notes: Starting cards as posted under START (9): Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe, Start Your Engines!, Executor: Holotheatre, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Visage Of The Emperor, Sebulba's Podracer, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Crush The Rebellion (the free Effect Start Your Engines! deploys, as the strategy explains) and Epic Duel; these count toward the 60. Boonta Eve Podrace is not listed.
Format Premiere - Coruscant: the description calls the deck post-Coruscant and it plays Coruscant cards (They Will Be No Match For You, Allegations Of Corruption, Maul Strikes, Focused Attack).
Visage Of The Emperor (unique) is posted once in START and x3 under Effects; 4 total kept as published (60 total).
Posted 'Their Fire Has Been Snuffed' dested the Objective's back side, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe.
Posted 'EPP Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Choke Vader' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith (the Vader who 'chokes'); 'Darth Maul (Tatooine)' dested Darth Maul.
Posted 'Grabber' dested Allegations Of Corruption, the Dark Coruscant Effect that stacks a just-played Interrupt (the strategy wants grabbers against WYS racing decks).

Posted 'Sebulba's Pod' dested Sebulba's Podracer; 'Omni Box/It's Worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Evader/Monnok' Evader & Monnok; 'Force Lightening' Force Lightning; 'Elis Herlot' Elis Helrot; 'Maul's Saber'/'Vader's Saber' Maul's Lightsaber/Vader's Lightsaber; 'Podrace Arena' and 'Tatooine Cantina' dested the Dark site pages.
Section headers carry no counts; the posted quantities total 60. The post is signed 'Michael "The Spider Monkey" Sorrell Jr.'
